title: Sensitive fluorescent biosensors based on a cascade signal amplification strategy and a stimuli-responsive hydrogel for the detection of the p53 gene.
authors: Wu, Xiaoya; Chen, Qiuhang; Zheng, Jianjun; Gao, Yuling; Cao, Yingjuan; Li, Zhixin; Chen, Zhiqin
one_liner_zh: 该文利用Cas12a反式切割活性与DNA水凝胶构建p53基因荧光生物传感器，虽涉及CRISPR/Cas12a切割，但核心是信号放大与检测应用，缺乏对切割或碱基编辑分子机制的研究，机制深度不足。
abstract: As a key tumor suppressor gene, the mutation and abnormal expression of p53 are closely correlated with tumor occurrence and progression, making p53 an important biomarker for early tumor diagnosis. Herein, a novel fluorescent biosensor based on a Cas12a/alkaline phosphatase (ALP) cascade signal amplification strategy and a stimuli-responsive DNA hydrogel was constructed for sensitive quantification of the p53 gene. Highly stable carbon dot/silica (CD/SiO(2)) composites were adopted as excellent fluorescent signal-sensing elements with outstanding optical stability in complex environments. An ALP-encapsulated hyaluronic acid (HA)-DNA hydrogel was prepared as a stimuli-responsive recognition element. Specific binding of the target p53 gene activates the trans-cleavage activity of CRISPR/Cas12a, which cleaves the HA-DNA hydrogel structure and triggers the release of ALP. The released ALP further catalyzes the hydrolysis of the p-nitrophenyl phosphate (PNPP) substrate to generate p-nitrophenol (PNP). The generated PNP quenches the fluorescence of CD/SiO(2) composites through the inner filter effect (IFE), and the fluorescence quenching value is positively correlated with the p53 gene concentration. The biosensor exhibited a favorable linear detection range of 1 pM-100 nM with a low detection limit of 0.074 pM. The proposed strategy eliminates cumbersome pre-amplification procedures for nucleic acids, provides a simple, sensitive and reliable new approach for p53 gene detection in complex biological samples, and exhibits great potential for early tumor auxiliary diagnosis and clinical biological analysis.
abstract_zh: 作为一种关键的肿瘤抑制基因，p53的突变和异常表达与肿瘤的发生和发展密切相关，使其成为早期肿瘤诊断的重要生物标志物。本研究构建了一种基于Cas12a/碱性磷酸酶（ALP）级联信号放大策略和刺激响应性DNA水凝胶的新型荧光生物传感器，用于p53基因的灵敏定量检测。采用高稳定性的碳点/二氧化硅（CD/SiO(2)）复合材料作为优异的荧光信号传感元件，在复杂环境中具有出色的光学稳定性。制备了封装ALP的透明质酸（HA）-DNA水凝胶作为刺激响应性识别元件。目标p53基因的特异性结合激活了CRISPR/Cas12a的反式切割活性，该活性切割HA-DNA水凝胶结构并触发ALP的释放。释放的ALP进一步催化对硝基苯磷酸（PNPP）底物的水解，生成对硝基苯酚（PNP）。生成的PNP通过内滤效应（IFE）猝灭CD/SiO(2)复合材料的荧光，且荧光猝灭值与p53基因浓度呈正相关。该生物传感器表现出良好的线性检测范围，为1 pM-100 nM，检测限低至0.074 pM。所提出的策略消除了核酸繁琐的预扩增步骤，为复杂生物样品中p53基因检测提供了一种简单、灵敏且可靠的新方法，并在早期肿瘤辅助诊断和临床生物分析中展现出巨大潜力。
